name: ProjectX
story: Wellington-based ProjectX built web mapping and addressing applications. In November 2009 its staff published Mapsicle 1.0, an open-source library that added interactive markers and information windows to Google Street View.

sources.label: John Clegg, ProjectX, Mapsicle 1.0: Annotating Street View Panoramas, 16 November 2009
